name: L’heure bleue
desc: The blue hour, held still. Your exact midnight blue, sea-glass accents and chalky ivory. Quiet, spacious, and the closest to the painting’s sky.
role: Elegant serif for reading and headings; crisp Plex Mono for the bar and terminal.

name: Terrasse verte
desc: An olive terrace after sundown. Lichen green and straw bring out the chairs, dress, and paper lanterns. Earthy with an Art Deco edge.
role: Geometric Josefin for interface headings; narrow, open Inconsolata for dense terminal work.

name: Rouge théâtre
desc: The red lantern becomes the lead. Oxblood shadows, dusty rose and soft pearl give the desktop a theatrical, late-night café mood.
role: High-contrast Bodoni for display; slender Victor Mono with distinctive italic letterforms for code.

name: Tabac & lumière
desc: A pool of lamplight on dark wood. Tobacco, honey and faded linen make the blue painting feel cooler by contrast. Tactile and warmly eccentric.
role: Soft, expressive Fraunces paired with the unmistakable shapes of Space Mono.

name: Pierrot
desc: The white costume against the dark crowd. Graphite and bone keep the interface almost monochrome; color appears only where it carries meaning.
role: Understated DM Sans for UI and reading; structured JetBrains Mono for a precise working desktop.
